svg.title: MediaLog — Boot log symbol
svg.desc: A pixel book drops down a navy-tuned four-shade handheld screen and lands, the way a cartridge logo arrives at power-on. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The handheld bezel with its long bottom-right curve frames a dot-matrix screen; the classic olive shades are retuned from pale sage to brand navy; The book descends in whole-pixel steps with a faint LCD ghost, then holds.
